thread:
olivia: quick help — client POC (acme) started getting 401s + occasional 429s after they updated credentials during onboarding.

ben: any logs from them?

olivia: pasted this from their dev: 

ben: ```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_user_temp_77\" -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp\" -H \"X-Redwood-Project: acme-frontend\" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"error\": \"invalid_token\",
  \"message\": \"token_project_mismatch: token bound to project 'proj-99', request project 'acme-frontend'\",
  \"code\": 401
}
```

kevin: that matches project-bound token checks. When project header != token.project we reject.

olivia: they also reported a couple of 429s right before the swap: 

ben: ```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  \"error\": \"rate_limit_exceeded\",
  \"message\": \"org-level RPS exceeded (burst)\",
  \"retry_after\": 12
}
```

kevin: likely two coincident issues: 1) They were hammering endpoints during onboarding (spike) -> temporary 429s. 2) Someone pasted a dev token scoped to a different project -> 401s when project header set.

sales-eng: customer asked if switching to org-managed service tokens or rotating keys will affect pricing/quota.

kevin: short answer: no pricing change just for token type. Quotas are tied to billing/org. If they change billing account or upgrade plan quotas change.

security-bot: tokens-audit: issuance and last-used timestamps are recorded; creator metadata is stored (console + tokens API). KMS-backed rotation & short-lived SSO tokens available.

olivia: remediation I recommended to them: 1) generate an org-scoped service token in Acme console with scopes needed (inference:invoke and inference:stream if using stream). 2) bind to the correct project (or remove X-Redwood-Project header if using org-scoped token without project restriction). 3) implement exponential backoff on client side for 429s. 4) use rdwctl for scripted rotation.

kevin: example rdwctl snippet: 

kevin: ```
# create org service token with invoke+stream scopes
rdwctl tokens create --org acme-corp --project acme-frontend --scopes inference:invoke,inference:stream --name \"acme-poc-svc\"
```

ben: repro I ran locally: swapped to a token bound to proj-99 then called with header X-Redwood-Project: acme-frontend -> got token_project_mismatch. Swap to token `sk_org_acme_prod` bound to acme-frontend -> success.

olivia: customer rotated to org token and added backoff. They report no more 401/429s in last 10m. :white_check_mark: 

sales-eng: can we get a 1-paragraph note for their security contact about visibility/audit?

kevin: sure: \"Redwood issues scoped tokens that include metadata (creator, issuance time, scopes, org/project binding) and records last-used timestamps. All token lifecycle events (create, revoke, rotate) are auditable via the console and tokens API. For higher security, customers can use short-lived SSO tokens or integrate KMS-backed rotation.\"

ben: action items: 
- ben: send repro + rdwctl snippet to their engineer.
- olivia: send security paragraph to customer security contact.
- kevin: monitor for further token_errors and RPS spikes.

security-bot: monitoring: acme-poc - token_errors cleared, avg_rps normalized.

olivia: thanks all — I'll update the CRM and close this auth swarm.

sales-eng: great job. follow-up thread for dedicated capacity sizing opened.
